title: Training-Free Domain Generation for One-Shot Federated Learning with Server-Side Pre-trained Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23908v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: One-shot federated learning (OSFL) has attracted increasing attention for its ability to substantially reduce communication overhead by limiting client-server interaction to a single communication round. Nevertheless, this limited interaction makes learning from heterogeneous client distributions challenging. Diffusion-based OSFL approaches seek to address this challenge by synthesizing data that approximate client distributions. However, existing diffusion-based approaches often impose substantial computational costs on clients and lack effective visual guidance to generate data aligned with client distributions. To address these limitations, we propose FedDoG, a training-free Domain Generation framework that leverages server-side pre-trained diffusion models to synthesize data aligned with client domains. translated_title: 面向单轮联邦学习的免训练域生成：利用服务器端预训练扩散模型
translated_abstract: 单轮联邦学习通过将客户端与服务器的交互限制在单轮通信中，大幅降低了通信开销，因而受到越来越多的关注。然而，这种有限的交互使得从异构的客户端分布中学习变得颇具挑战性。基于扩散模型的单轮联邦学习方法试图通过合成近似客户端分布的数据来应对这一挑战。然而，现有的基于扩散模型的方法通常给客户端带来巨大的计算成本，且缺乏有效的视觉引导来生成与客户端分布对齐的数据。为解决这些局限，我们提出了FedDoG，一个免训练的域生成框架，它利用服务器端预训练的扩散模型来合成与客户端域对齐的数据。FedDoG使用冻结的图像编码器提取紧凑的域表示，大幅降低了客户端的计算与通信开销。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出免训练的域生成框架FedDoG，利用服务器端预训练的扩散模型，并以冻结图像编码器提取的紧凑域表示作为引导，为单轮联邦学习合成与异构客户端分布对齐的数据，同时大幅降低客户端的计算与通信成本。
en_tdlr: FedDoG is a training-free domain generation framework for one-shot federated learning that leverages server-side pre-trained diffusion models, guided by compact domain representations from a frozen image encoder, to synthesize data aligned with heterogeneous client distributions while substantially reducing client-side computational and communication costs.
